findings.title: _start_tasks_inherited keys on live HEAD, not the recorded cut — fails open when $integ was merged into the operator's branch and then advanced (merge-base becomes the merged-in integ commit, planned tasks read as inherited, witness silently off), and fails closed (original refusal, inapplicable recovery) when HEAD sits on a pre-cut branch or start is re-run from inside the integration worktree
test_start.sh Part 10 records setup failure with fail() but keeps driving the missing $r27wt, so a setup break buries itself under cascade failures (Part 9 guards the same shape with if/else)
